findings.summary: Native async KV lookahead exclusion and multi-group invalid-block handling already replace donor v0.23 scheduler patches.
Native shared-page reconstruction and V41 cache configuration preserve target/index/folded/alias physical ownership; remote metadata lacks named semantic layout attestation.
A-side V2 request history and Engram ModelState own lookback preparation and execution retirement.
Native DSpark prompt-draft-context lifecycle exists under SfaRemoteD2H selection, but its consumer requires sparse offload that rejects V41 compression.
Ordinary MTP V2 has separate prefill/decode managers; Ascend FULL decode captures all N-1 remaining steps as one graph, unlike donor MRV1 single runnable wrapping.
Native explicitly rejects classic MTP for V41; DSpark uses a different speculator and must not be counted as remote ordinary MTP.

recommended_next_increment: A plugin-owned runtime P/D layout collector and strict pre-transfer attestation consumer, retaining all existing native lifecycle and current eligibility; see paired markdown for exact proposed API and staged ordinary-MTP migration.
